create_model_group: create a new access group with model names or model IDs for simplified access control
list_access_groups: list all access groups with their model names and deployment counts
get_access_group_info: get information about a specific access group by name
update_access_group: update an access group's model names or model IDs, removing old and adding new deployments
delete_access_group: delete an access group and remove it from all deployments
